notes: https://carbondesignsystem.com/ redirects (200 after redirect) to https://www.carbondesignsystem.com/ — a Next.js/Payload CMS site whose CSS ships Carbon v11 tokens as --cds-* custom properties.

:root declares the g10 theme; all 235 :root --cds-* color tokens that exist in @carbon/themes g10 match exactly (0 diffs). Page body background is --cds-background #f4f4f4; header/cards use layer-01 #ffffff.

No site-wide dark mode: no prefers-color-scheme rule for tokens, no toggle, emulating dark changes nothing. But the CTA statement block and the footer are wrapped in .cds--g100, so g100 colors (#161616 bg, #f4f4f4 text, #c6c6c6 secondary text, #525252 border, #78a9ff link) are rendered in those zones — an extractor that reports them as 'dark' values is reading theme zones, not a dark mode.

The CSS also contains .cds--white/.cds--g10/.cds--g90/.cds--g100 and .cds--chart-holder[data-carbon-theme=*] theme classes; only g10 (root), white (one header popover wrapper) and g100 (CTA, footer) appear in the home page HTML.
Radius omitted: Carbon is square; no element on the home page computed a non-zero border-radius.

Spacing/font sizes measured from computed styles at the default Playwright viewport; responsive values may differ. Used-but-not-token values excluded: spacing 7/10/14/15/20/26px, font size 64px (hero heading; not in the Carbon type scale).
Link text often renders #002d9c (blue-80) and some backgrounds #bae6ff (cyan-20) / #001d6c — these are Carbon palette colors applied by site CSS, not g10 theme tokens.

A stray Tailwind/shadcn-style rule body{background-color:var(--background)} with --background:oklch(...) exists in an earlier stylesheet but is overridden by Carbon's body rule; ignore --background/--foreground.
robots.txt: User-agent * Disallow: /admin/* only — home page allowed. Note it carries Content-Signal: ai-train=no, search=yes, ai-input=yes.
